question_options.question: How would you rate this episode?
Have you ever liked two people at once?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look, Spencer... I know I should be the last one offering anybody else dating advice.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's certainly true! You and Paige were a disaster!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Urp! Well, look over there! Some cups need organizing!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The point is... I'm not great at relationships...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I `do` know there's no way to start one without telling a girl how you feel.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] know there's no way to start one without telling a girl how you feel.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The longer you wait, the harder it gets. So... You may as well just go for it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know, man... Things didn't exactly work out great for me last time I tried to date someone...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sam basically put me in the friend zone after a few dates.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, I remember...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then she started chasing that pretty boy hipster, Nick...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...And even got back together with him after he broke her heart!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I admit, that was pretty rough...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe girls are just too dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Listen, man. Sam and $ALLISON are way different people...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And it's like Coach says, 'You can't make any tackles from the sidelines.'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I thought he was just explaining the rules.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's sometimes hard to tell...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The point is... Go for it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll think about it...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I did overhear you talking with $ALLISON about tutoring...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I just assumed that was all a cover story so you'd get to spend time with her.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I `do` need some help... Especially in English!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] need some help... Especially in English!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean, have you heard me talk? I don't speak good!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think you mean, 'I don't speak `well'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think you mean, 'I don't speak [color=#e23b3b][i]well'.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... You're saying you don't like $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? No! I mean yes! I mean... Why? Did she say something about me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. Come on, man. It's obvious you like $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It `is?` You think she can tell?!
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#e23b3b][i]is?[/i][/color] You think she can tell?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Haha. Lucky for you, she's pretty clueless...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Phew.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But if you like her, don't you `want` her to know?
nodes.text_bbcode: But if you like her, don't you [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] her to know?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know! I guess... Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's the matter? You do like her right?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know how I feel about... Feelings.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: See, you seem like the kind of girl who might sit around over-thinking things...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Who should I date? Should I date anyone at all? Do I have a connection with this guy or that guy?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ah! I enjoy such existential questions!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: For example, does love exist or is it merely a social construct? Do `I` even exist? Is reality nothing but an illusion?
nodes.text_bbcode: For example, does love exist or is it merely a social construct? Do [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] even exist? Is reality nothing but an illusion?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Okay. I didn't realize we were dealing with `that` level of over-thinking.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Okay. I didn't realize we were dealing with [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] level of over-thinking.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The point is... Sometimes you just stop thinking and go for it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think I see your point...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...but `which` guy do I really want to date? Cameron... Or Spencer?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...but [color=#3b78e2][i]which[/i][/color] guy do I really want to date? Cameron... Or Spencer?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Spencer.
At football practice, Spencer watches sadly from the sidelines as the other guys play.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Go long!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Arm's looking good as ever, Nate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Naturally.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's the point of life if I can't even lay some smack down on the football field?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you kidding? As water boys, we can play an essential role in the team's hydration!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I keep telling you! I'm not a water boy! I'm on the injured reserve!
Owen comes by...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... Thirsty...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Go on! Hand him a cup of water!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not going to...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hydration...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine... Might as well make myself useful.
Spencer attempts to get up and hand Owen a cup of water...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoops!
He ends up falling over on his crutches, spilling water everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You okay, buddy?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not by a longshot.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Last year I was the king of this field!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This year I can't even hand out water!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... There are always `other things` you can concentrate on.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... There are always [color=#e23b3b][i]other things[/i][/color] you can concentrate on.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Other things,' huh? I guess you must mean...
$ALLISON continues learning about Paige's dating strategy.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...so you just have the waiter write his number on a coaster and slip it into your purse!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And if your guy asks, tell him you're looking for waiters for your next birthday party!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not sure how this particular scenario applies to my situation...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding? In this scenario, Cameron is the waiter! `Now` do you see?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? In this scenario, Cameron is the waiter! [color=#3b78e2][i]Now[/i][/color] do you see?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think I'm leaving this lesson more confused than ever...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is hopeless. I'm going to do a five-minute makeup touchup, then I'm coming right back for your next lesson.
Paige leaves.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $ALLISON, wait... Let me give you just `one` piece of advice, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: $ALLISON, wait... Let me give you just [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] piece of advice, okay?

nodes.text: Paige continues her story about the waiter at the yacht party and begins to draw an elaborate flow chart explaining her strategy...
When Paige's back is turned, Kimi whispers in your ear.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Honestly, I don't have the best track record with guys...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It took me forever to get together with Kevin, mostly because I was so unsure how I felt about him.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm beginning to understand the feeling of uncertainty that you're describing.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Even now, I'm sometimes unsure what my feelings are...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But I'm still glad Kevin and I got together.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Even if we don't work out in the long term, I've still learned a lot from dating him, and we've had some great times!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That... Actually makes a lot of sense.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If inexperience is my chief difficulty, the only solution is to... Get some experience!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Exactly!
In the meantime, Paige finishes her story about the waiter and the yacht.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...and if your guy gets jealous, just dump him the next day!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... Right. Great advice!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now stay put. I'm going to do a five-minute makeup touchup. Then I'm coming right back for your next lesson.
Paige leaves.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just one more thing, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So I'm 'Mature'?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure. Think about it...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Have you ever threatened to kill a guy because he accidentally brought you a nonfat soy latte but forgot the simple syrup?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't even drink coffee!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And have you ever thrown a hysterical fit because you caught your boyfriend talking to another girl at the mall...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...and then it turns out that girl is his 35-year-old aunt?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: First, I've never had a boyfriend. And second, no. That has never happened.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In that case, my dear, you are officially mature. Put-together. Low-maintenance.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess I am.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yep. By high school girl standards? Absolutely.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Even `I` once snapped Kevin's copy of 'Call of Battle 4' in half when he forgot the two month anniversary of our second kiss!
nodes.text_bbcode: Even [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] once snapped Kevin's copy of 'Call of Battle 4' in half when he forgot the two month anniversary of our second kiss!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So you're 'mature', $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But you're also hopelessly ill-equipped for dating!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I must agree with you on that point... Any advice would be appreciated!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's just what I wanted to hear!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's time for some flirting bootcamp.
Two minutes later, $ALLISON and Kimi sit in a classroom as Paige paces in front of them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pop-quiz. You're standing at your locker when Cameron comes up and asks you to lunch.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you do, $ALLISON? `What do you do?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you do, $ALLISON? [color=#3b78e2][i]What do you do?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Check my schedule and help him pick a restaurant?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Wrong!` You tell him that you already have plans with Trevor!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Wrong![/i][/color] You tell him that you already have plans with Trevor!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Who's Trevor?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `There is no Trevor!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]There is no Trevor![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I get it. Trevor is girl code for, 'You're not the only hot guy chasing after me.'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Did I give you permission to speak?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Did I give you permission to speak?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay. Another scenario. You're at a yacht party with your guy when a hot waiter starts getting flirty...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think I recognize this question from 'Rich Girl' magazine!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Pssst... $ALLISON. I'm not sure this advice is really going to help you. Want to hear a few of `my` tips instead?
nodes.text_bbcode: Pssst... $ALLISON. I'm not sure this advice is really going to help you. Want to hear a few of [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] tips instead?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well...

options.label: I think Paige is making some good points.
I'd like to get your perspective, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Excellent. The number one thing I look for in a student is a willingness to learn.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Learning is one of my favorite things to do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See... Phrases like that aren't going to fly if you want to land Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, if I'm so bad at this, what makes you think I've got a chance at all?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's simple, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You may be naive, nerdy, and socially inept...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But Cameron seems to think of you as `mature!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But Cameron seems to think of you as [color=#3b78e2][i]mature![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Are you saying I'm jealous of you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Not exactly... But it seems to me you may be frustrated with your own romantic situation.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And just what `situation` are you talking about?
nodes.text_bbcode: And just what [color=#3b78e2][i]situation[/i][/color] are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... No situation. No situation at all!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I mean, it's not like it's totally obvious that you still have feelings for Owen and are too immature to admit it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `What did you just say?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What did you just say?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It seems unnecessary to repeat my sentence.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let me tell you something about `maturity,` $ALLISON.
nodes.text_bbcode: Let me tell you something about [color=#3b78e2][i]maturity,[/i][/color] $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's the one thing you've got going for you when it comes to Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Just so you know, Cameron has kind of a bad reputation...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But I went out with him once, and he turned out to be a total gentleman!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's a hot bad boy with a heart of gold!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This is... A lot of information.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't look now, but he's walking this way!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey there, $ALLISON. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's going swimmingly.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey. No fair stealing my line. I'm the `swimmer` here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey. No fair stealing my line. I'm the [color=#e23b3b][i]swimmer[/i][/color] here.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't believe you have a trademark on aquatic terminology.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Well, I'll forgive you just this once, but you owe me one now.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I hardly see how I'm in your debt.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Come on! You're kicking a man when he's down. You `know` I just broke up with Veronica...
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on! You're kicking a man when he's down. You [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] I just broke up with Veronica...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You... May have mentioned that last time we spoke.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah... Let's just say I'm looking for someone a little more... Mature.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That seems like a good course of action.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Anyway, see you around, $ALLISON.
Cameron smiles and walks away.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That was...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Horrible!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Where did `you` come from?
nodes.text_bbcode: Where did [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] come from?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've been listening to this whole pathetic conversation, trying to bite my tongue.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lately, I've been trying not to care about dances or flirting or boys...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I just can't stand by and accept this level of `incompetence!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But I just can't stand by and accept this level of [color=#3b78e2][i]incompetence![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That seems like a bit of an exaggeration.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding? $ALLISON, if you don't improve your flirting skills ASAP, you're going to miss out on dating the hottest guy at school!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: My conversational methods seem to be holding me in good stead so far.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm trying to help! Are you ready to listen?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, apparently...

options.label: You feel a need to live vicariously through me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I knew it! My `girl sense` has been tingling ever since the Autumn Festival!
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew it! My [color=#3b78e2][i]girl sense[/i][/color] has been tingling ever since the Autumn Festival!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It `has?`
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]has?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I saw your whole conversation! It's so obvious you have a crush...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: On `Cameron!`
nodes.text_bbcode: On [color=#3b78e2][i]Cameron![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Allison looks across the crowd of swimmers, to where Cameron is hanging out with his senior friends.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I must admit, my heart is racing, and for some reason my palms are sweating.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah. That's called a crush.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Could I possibly have feelings for both Spencer `and` Cameron?
nodes.text_bbcode: Could I possibly have feelings for both Spencer [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G., you're totally blushing! I knew you liked Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks for letting me in on your little secret! I feel like we're totally bonding!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh... Good. Yes. Good.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G.! You really are clueless, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that a thing people have been saying about me?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean... I'm just saying you're not seeing the obvious.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: There's a guy that totally seems interested in you!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is it that obvious?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course! It's plain as day!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Cameron` totally has a thing for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cameron[/i][/color] totally has a thing for you!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron?
Allison looks across the crowd of swimmers, to where Cameron is hanging out with his senior friends.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I must admit, my heart is racing, and for some reason my palms are sweating.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah. That's called a crush.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Could I possibly have feelings for both Spencer `and` Cameron?
nodes.text_bbcode: Could I possibly have feelings for both Spencer [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G., you're totally blushing! I knew you liked Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I just wish you would have fessed up to it in the first place! I thought we were friends!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I apologize?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Great move, $ALLISON! Time alone with Spencer should afford you a perfect chance to assess your feelings!
After detention is over...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did you hear about the dance? Did you `hear` about the dance? `Did you hear about the dance?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you hear about the dance? Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]hear[/i][/color] about the dance? [color=#3b78e2][i]Did you hear about the dance?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course. I was standing right next to you.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm `so` excited! I wonder how Kevin will officially ask me...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] excited! I wonder how Kevin will officially ask me...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe he'll write 'Kimi, will you go to the dance with me?' in rocks on the side of a mountain...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...And then have me look at the message through binoculars!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That sounds... Elaborate!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Or maybe he'll stand up in front of everyone in the cafeteria and ask me in the form of a poem!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Unless that's uncool? Is that uncool?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are these... Convoluted proposals... Really a part of the school's pre-dance ritual?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: For sure! Ooooh! Look over there!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Looks like swim practice just got out! And now Ben is asking Emily to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily, friends, if you would please follow me, there's a question I need to ask...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: A question, huh?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now, if you would please follow me and look up at the sky...
As Emily and the crowd watch in awe, Ben takes out a book of matches and lights several large rockets!
They fly up into the sky, exploding in a shower of sparks.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: O.M.G.! Pretty fireworks! I love the blue ones!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's the copper chloride! I really hope we get to see some barium chloride ones!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $ALLISON? English?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry! Green ones. I meant green ones.
The final firework explodes, forming the words 'Emily, Dance? -Ben'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Of course I'll go with you!
Ben and Emily embrace.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That was good, right? Good not great. Like, I'm sure Kevin can top that.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh, yes. Almost certainly.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What about you? Do you think anyone will ask you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You'd really help me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course! I'd love to tutor you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's like the two of us... At a desk?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That would certainly facilitate the tutoring process.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That sounds... Uh, great! I could really use the help.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I don't pull at least a `3.0 GPA,` my scholarship for the Steelman Program gets revoked.
nodes.text_bbcode: If I don't pull at least a [color=#e23b3b][i]3.0 GPA,[/i][/color] my scholarship for the Steelman Program gets revoked.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I helped you get that scholarship... There's no way I'm going to let you lose it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Cool. Thanks.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm happy to help!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
